cohort: A total of 502 women intending to labour or birth in water at a tertiary maternity hospital in Western Australia between July 2015 and June 2016.
finding: Women who birthed in water experienced significantly shorter first, second, and third stages of labour and had an increased likelihood of an intact perineum.
mod_finding: Women who birthed in water were at increased odds of having shorter first, second, and third stage labours and an intact perineum.
